zh-CN.batch.behavior.detail: VoxWeave 会排除输出目录、按内容身份去重，并让单个失败文件独立收口。持续监控不会改变其它文件，也不会覆盖已有成品。

en.batch.behavior.detail: VoxWeave excludes the output folder, deduplicates by content identity, and isolates failures per file. Watching never changes unrelated files or overwrites completed output.
en.empty.models.title: No models available yet
en.empty.models.detail: Scan the default roots, choose an external folder, or import a model above.
en.empty.models.short: Add a model in the library first

en.storage.archive.confirm_title: Archive and release the active folder?
en.storage.archive.confirm_detail: VoxWeave verifies the archived files before moving them out of the active artifacts folder. Completed output files are not modified. Continue?
